_comment: Counter pair <prefix>_cache_hits_total / <prefix>_cache_misses_total; emits one panel with three queries: hit rate (cps), miss rate (cps), hit ratio (percentunit).

pair_metrics._comment: Pair partner — required for the pair_with: suffix_swap to resolve. Does not itself Match() the recipe (Match keys on _cache_hits_total).
pair_metrics.name: redis_cache_misses_total

negative_metrics._comment: Look-alike: misses-side counter alone never matches (Match keys on hits suffix).
negative_metrics.name: http_cache_misses_total

expected_panels.query_contains: sum by (instance, job) (rate(redis_cache_hits_total[5m])) / (sum by (instance, job) (rate(redis_cache_hits_total[5m])) + sum by (instance, job) (rate(redis_cache_misses_total[5m])))
